notes:
- In-app details from the Activity feed and Currently Arriving: Tapping an entry in a profile's Activity tab, or a card in the dashboard's Currently Arriving row, now opens AniSequel's own detail sheet — synopsis, community scores, rankings, genres, specs and an AniList link — instead of sending you straight to the browser. Those rows were a dead end before: only a missed sequel had a detail view, so the screen that carries AniList's description and ratings could not be reached from the feed. The on-demand detail query now fetches the entry's full record, so these rows get the same header, artwork and specs a sequel already had.
- The detail sheet adapts to what it is showing: An entry with no parent shows an About tab instead of Story & Gaps, and drops the "Sequel to …" card and the add-to-list gesture that would mean nothing for a show already on your list. The AniList link is still there on every entry.

Build 139 from 59af3b6f.
